author_reading_scope: Eleven distinct retained source documents were inspected at the relevant full-text locators recorded below: the six original A-page sources, four algebra sources for the fixed-field and Laurent-curve lemmas, and Petersen’s independent figure-eight paper. No successful direct-fetch stamp is claimed for that report.

source_resolution.reason: Full-text inspection shows the displayed generic matrices do not lie in SL2(C): each has determinant M^2, not 1. The report also treats simultaneous upper-triangularization as available for every representation, which cannot justify an irreducible character component. It is therefore unsuitable as an independent calculation source.
source_resolution.search_summary: After six failed direct PDF fetches (the initial attempt and five retries, all HTTP 500), a web search for the report title located the report’s full-text body. The visible full-text section was inspected; no successful direct-fetch stamp is claimed.

searches.query: Will Stavely "An Introduction to the AJ Conjecture" PDF report figure eight knot
searches.outcome: Search returned the original report with its full-text body, including §2.3; inspection exposed the determinant mismatch and unsupported all-representations triangularization premise.

alternatives.argument: Conditional on the independently stated trace identity in the item’s [F1] and the common-peripheral-eigenline identities in [F2], substitute x=M+M^{-1} into tr(lambda)=x^4-5x^2+2 and multiply by M^4L to obtain the displayed Laurent polynomial Q. This verifies the finite trace-to-Laurent algebra only; [A1] and [A2] still mark the trace-curve derivation and boundary-image completeness as unresolved.
